options.name: anonymous_gid
options.description: Specifies the group ID of the anonymous account. If not specified at the time of creation, it will be set to -2.

options.name: anonymous_uid
options.description: Specifies the user ID of the anonymous account. If not specified at the time of creation, it will be set to -2.

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: default_access
options.description: Default access level for all hosts that can access the Export. For hosts that need different access than the default, they can be configured by adding to the list. If I(default_access) is not mentioned during creation, then NFS export will be created with C(No_Access).

options.name: description
options.description: The description for the NFS export.

options.name: filesystem
options.description: The ID/Name of the filesystem for which the NFS export will be created. Either filesystem or snapshot is required for creation of the NFS Export. If filesystem name is specified, then I(nas_server) is required to uniquely identify the filesystem. If I(filesystem) parameter is provided, then I(snapshot) cannot be specified.

options.name: host_state
options.description: Define whether the hosts can access the NFS export. Required when adding or removing host access from the export.

options.name: is_no_suid
options.description: If set, do not allow access to set SUID. Otherwise, allow access. If not specified at the time of creation, it will be set to C(false).

options.name: min_security
options.description: NFS enforced security type for users accessing an NFS export. If not specified at the time of creation, it will be set to C(SYS).

options.name: nas_server
options.description: The NAS server. This could be the name or ID of the NAS server.

options.name: nfs_export_id
options.description: The ID of the NFS export.

options.name: nfs_export_name
options.description: The name of the NFS export. Mandatory for create operation. Specify either I(nfs_export_name) or I(nfs_export_id) but not both for any operation.

options.name: no_access_hosts
options.description: Hosts with no access to the NFS export.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: path
options.description: Local path to export relative to the NAS server root. With NFS, each export of a file_system or file_snap must have a unique local path. Mandatory while creating NFS export.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: read_only_hosts
options.description: Hosts with read-only access to the NFS export.

options.name: read_only_root_hosts
options.description: Hosts with read-only access for root user to the NFS export.

options.name: read_write_hosts
options.description: Hosts with read and write access to the NFS export.

options.name: read_write_root_hosts
options.description: Hosts with read and write access for root user to the NFS export.

options.name: snapshot
options.description: The ID/Name of the Snapshot for which NFS export will be created. Either I(filesystem) or I(snapshot) is required for creation of the NFS Export. If snapshot name is specified, then I(nas_server) is required to uniquely identify the snapshot. If I(snapshot) parameter is provided, then I(filesystem) cannot be specified. NFS export can be created only if access type of snapshot is "protocol".

options.name: state
options.description: Define whether the NFS export should exist or not.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
